reading: Authored values are right-shaped (median 2.6pp) but ~12% have gross errors >=8pp, concentrated in W5 (pure estimation). W6->W7 deltas average ~3pp true magnitude — comparable to the transcription noise. CONCLUSION: temporal deltas are noise-dominated at current provenance; full database verification REQUIRED before any temporal claim is published. Cross-sectional (GOQA) unaffected — real data.
